parameters.query:
WITH deletes_detectados AS (
    SELECT
        query,
        rows,
        calls,
        mean_exec_time
    FROM public.pg_stat_statements
    WHERE query ~* '^\s*DELETE\s+FROM\s+'
      AND query !~* '\mWHERE\M'
      AND query ~* '\m(clientes|ventas|productos|lotes_produccion|plantas|materias_primas|gastos|control_calidad)\M'
      AND rows > 100
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS total_deletes,
    COALESCE(MAX(rows), 0)::bigint AS filas_eliminadas,
    COALESCE(MAX(calls), 0)::bigint AS ejecuciones,
    COALESCE(
        STRING_AGG(query, ' | '),
        'Ninguna'
    ) AS consultas,
    COUNT(*) > 0 AS alerta_d1
FROM deletes_detectados;
